{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` parses JavaScript construct signatures into a member name and an argument list.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` takes a parameter `sig`, a string containing the signature of the JavaScript construct.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` takes a parameter `signode`, a node used by Sphinx to build the final HTML output.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` returns a tuple containing two strings: the full name of the construct and its prefix.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` uses `rsplit` to separate the member name from its prefix, if present.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` parses the argument list, when present in the signature, using the helper function `_pseudo_parse_arglist`.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` checks configuration settings for maximum line length and whether to display parameters on a single line.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` catches `ValueError` exceptions raised when splitting the member name from its prefix.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "When a `ValueError` is caught in `JSObject.handle_signature`, the function uses the entire signature as the member name without a prefix.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` uses an early return when the signature does not contain an argument list.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` adds nodes representing the parsed information to `signode`, which are later rendered into HTML.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `JSObject.handle_signature` updates the Sphinx environment's reference context with the parsed prefix and full name.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
